title: Goat Horn Conversion
description: Adds the ability to convert a goat horn variant to another variant by using the Smithing Table.
body:
# Goat Horn Sound Conversion
Goat Horn Conversion adds 4 new Smithing Table recipes, which are used to convert **any goat horn's sound variant** into one of the 4 variants that **do not drop from goats**.

## Recipes
All recipes require a feather, any goat horn variant and a valid material, the pictures below show what variant certain materials give.  

![Sing Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/176ae27f52018cde0fc67e2adca62a05d6bd84d1.png)
![Ponder Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/592d3181153e093520a56eeb72d0049b54d97f3e.png)
![Feel Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ac8898cdb0fcc7f81f49c700e3c121f49d213ee5.png)
![Seek Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e5fc5033e03057fd123f7666e4b8d6da0de2310b.png)

This datapack is compatible with JEI and similar recipe-lookup mods.  
**This datapack was only tested for 1.21.1 but should be compatible with every version above 1.19.**
